The layered-control model holds and has escalated: HORMUZ=OPEN remains false, impairment is now kinetic, not administrative.
- MACRO — CPI TOMORROW IS THE ARBITER: August CPI releases Sep 11, the final inflation print before the Sep 15–16 FOMC; PPI lands today. Euro area flash August inflation 3.2% (Eurostat via OECD). Preserved contradiction: post-Jackson-Hole markets priced ~54% odds of a September HIKE; after the payroll contraction (July NFP −23k, revisions cutting the 12-month average to ~34k/month) the September hike trade was half-dismantled (42–46%) and cut expectations rebuilt. Direction of the September decision is genuinely unresolved — do not average; CPI resolves or escalates.
